hero.title: Begin Your Journey at SRU
hero.subtitle: Your path to academic excellence starts here. Discover our straightforward admissions process designed to welcome outstanding students.

steps.title: Your Path to Admission
steps.subtitle: Follow these simple steps to complete your application and secure your place at SRU.

items.title: Create Your Account
items.description: Register on the SRU Admissions Portal with your email address and personal details to get started.

items.title: Choose Your Program
items.description: Browse our 80+ academic programs and select the college and major that aligns with your goals.

items.title: Submit Documents
items.description: Upload all required documents including transcripts, certificates, and identification through the secure portal.

items.title: Receive Decision
items.description: Our admissions team will review your application and notify you within 14 business days.

documents.title: Documents Checklist
documents.subtitle: Prepare the following documents before starting your application to ensure a smooth process.

items.label: Medical Report for Special Conditions (if applicable)

dates.title: Admission Dates 2026
dates.subtitle: Ensure you adhere to the following dates to guarantee your application is processed in time.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
scholarships.subtitle: We believe academic excellence should never be limited by finances. SRU offers a comprehensive package of scholarships and financial support.

items.title: Academic Excellence Scholarship
items.description: Awarded to outstanding students with excellent high school GPA and distinguished scores on admission tests.

items.title: Financial Need Grant
items.description: A grant dedicated to outstanding students facing financial hardship, ensuring merit-worthy students can access higher education.

items.title: Community Service Award
items.description: Honours students who embody a spirit of giving and volunteering, contributing actively to serving their communities.

cta.title: Ready to Achieve Your Academic Dream?
cta.subtitle: Submit your application now through our secure online portal and begin your academic journey with SRU. The process is easy and fast — apply in under 30 minutes.
